documents.text: Leeds Boar Lane. Cust Ms Ayesha Rahman came in approx 12.30, upset. Wanted to dispute £35 overdraft charges on Oct statement. Says she would not have gone into unarranged o/d if she could have moved money on Fri 30/10 but couldnt log in to app all day. Also says when she came in Sat 31/10 to ask about it, colleague DH told her 'the app was fine, you must have forgotten your password' and 'there's nothing I can do, it's in the T&Cs', in front of other customers, and walked off while she was talking. She found this humiliating. I apologised, explained I cant refund fees in branch, told her it will be logged as a complaint and complaints team will call her back. She gave mobile 0113 496 0582. - K Osei

Subject: Complaint from yesterday at Boar Lane

Hi,

I was in the Boar Lane branch yesterday and the man there (Kwame) was really kind and said I'd get a call. I want to put it in writing as well so nothing gets missed.

1. I was charged £35 in overdraft fees for October. I only went overdrawn because I couldn't get into my app on Friday 30th to move my money across from my savings. I want that refunded.
2. The staff member I spoke to on Saturday, Dean, was rude and dismissive. He told me I'd forgotten my password in front of a queue of people, which was embarrassing, and then just walked away. I want an apology and for someone to speak to him.
3. Your app was down for most of Friday, which was payday for a lot of people. Nobody told me anything, there was no message in the app or a text. I want to know what happened and that it won't happen again.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account 3447 0921
